subject: Remit waterfall and entity stitching for Crescent Diagnostics billing
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Priyanka Rao <priya@crescentdx.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Remit waterfall and entity stitching for Crescent Diagnostics billing

Hi Priyanka —

Thanks for the context on your finance team's need to map payments to three legal entities (US ops, EU holding, APAC services) while keeping a single consolidated customer statement. I've attached a working remittance matrix and a short Redwood playbook that outlines our recommended approach. High level I propose: 

- Single invoice stream per invoice run, with line-level entity tags (entity_id) so your AR system can auto-route receipts to the correct ledger.
- Remit waterfall: payments first apply to entity-specific VAT liabilities, then to the invoice line balances on a priority mapping we can make explicit by product code.
- Credit notes and refunds — route to the same entity as the original line item; global credits can be flagged for manual review.

I attached Crescent_Remittance_Matrix_v2.xlsx showing an example mapping, and Redwood_MultiEntity_Guide_2026.pdf with token-level examples and API fields you'll need for automated reconciliation.

Questions for your AP/AR team before we lock the mapping:
1) Do you require separate invoice numbers per legal entity, or OK to use a single invoice number with entity_line references?
2) Any country-specific VAT reclaim routing rules we should encode now (e.g., Hungarian reverse charge, UK margin scheme)?
3) Expected weekly invoice cadence and whether you'll use direct debit or bank transfer for settlement.

If you like, we can run a sample export for one month and do a joint walk-through. 

Best,
Sooj

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:03:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Remit waterfall and entity stitching for Crescent Diagnostics billing

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the thorough note and the attachments. Quick answers below and a couple of clarifications: 

1) We prefer a single invoice number per billing cycle (consolidated statement) but absolutely need line-level entity attribution for downstream ledger posting.
2) We do have a couple of quirks: for EU orders where VAT is charged, the EU holding company must receive the VAT portion for our reclaim flows. For APAC (Singapore), certain service fees are zero-rated but reconciliation must show the supporting proof.
3) Weekly cadence works; bank transfer is our primary method.

Open question: can Redwood emit a separate electronic remittance advice (ERA) file per payment that lists applied entity allocations? Our team would like that to automate unapplied cash cleansing.

Happy to jump on a call next week. 

PRIYA
Priyanka Rao
Head of Finance Operations
Crescent Diagnostics
priya@crescentdx.com

Priya —

Yes, we can emit an ERA (CSV or JSON schema) per payment that includes: payment_id, applied_amount, entity_id, line_reference, and vat_component. That ERA can be pushed to your SFTP or to a secure endpoint in your billing system.

Notes from Karthik (cc'd) and Marissa on operational constraints:
- Karthik: Redwood's default invoice generation uses a single invoice series by customer. We will add an entity_line_code to each invoice row. That keeps printing and reporting consolidated but allows AR automation.
- Marissa: For refunds/credits, we'll implement a priority rule: match by original invoice_line_id, then fallback to invoice-level residuals. We'll also provide a remittance report for every lock-run.

Action items:
- Soojin to produce a sample ERA for the Oct billing run and share with Crescent finance by EOD Tuesday.
- Crescent to confirm if they want entity-specific invoice numbering in addition to the line_code (yes/no).
- Schedule a 30m technical handoff with Crescent AP on Thursday 11/25.

I'll attach the sample ERA when ready.

Best,
Sooj

- We do NOT need separate invoice numbering at this time; single invoice number + line-level entity_code is sufficient.
- We want the ERA pushed to our SFTP (sftp.crescentdx.com:/incoming/remits).
- AP will be on the 11/25 handoff call; I'll send a calendar invite for 09:00 IST / 20:30 PST and include our AP tech lead (Anand Kumar).

One more ask: can you include a short mapping table in the sample ERA showing tax treatment per entity (tax_rate, reclaim_required boolean)? That will speed our automation.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Priya
